findings.summary: Destructive action buttons use the hardcoded Tailwind color text-red-700 instead of the --danger design token, so they do not adapt to dark theme and drift from the brand danger color.
findings.fix: Replace `btn-secondary text-red-700` with `btn-secondary text-[var(--danger)]` on all destructive buttons (revoke device, revoke access, reject break-glass, reject privacy) at lines 80, 82, 84, 86 so they use the token that responds to [data-theme='dark'].

findings.summary:
The loading state is a bespoke plain `

جارٍ تحميل…

` instead of the shared LoadingScreen spinner/branding used across the app.
findings.fix: Import and render `<LoadingScreen label="جارٍ تحميل بيانات الحوكمة…" />` (from ../../ui/LoadingScreen) when query.isLoading, matching the loading pattern used by sibling pages.

findings.summary: The devices table is a hand-rolled `<table>` with raw utility classes (bg-[var(--surface-muted)], p-4, border-t) rather than the shared .data-table class used elsewhere, causing spacing/border inconsistencies.
findings.fix: Apply the shared `.data-table` class to the `<table>` (and drop the redundant per-cell p-4/border-t/bg utilities) so device listing matches the app's canonical table styling and cell padding.

findings.summary: The tab navigation buttons convey the active tab only via btn-primary vs btn-secondary styling, with no aria-selected/aria-current, so assistive tech cannot tell which section is active.
findings.fix: Add `aria-current={tab===value ? 'page' : undefined}` (or use role="tab"/aria-selected on a role="tablist" container) to each nav button so the active section is exposed to screen readers, not color-only.

findings.summary:
Empty lists render a plain `

لا توجد…

` (lines 82, 84, 86) instead of the shared EmptyState primitive already imported and used for the error state.
findings.fix: Replace the bespoke muted paragraphs with `<EmptyState title=... description=... />` (e.g. title="لا توجد عناصر مراجعة معلقة") so empty states are visually consistent with the rest of the app.

findings.summary: Policy cards mix inconsistent card padding (p-5 here vs the devices/access panels using border-b header + p-5 body), and the release cards use p-5 while metric grid and forms vary, giving uneven spacing across tabs.
findings.fix: Standardize card internal padding to the app convention (p-5 body with a bordered header where a title exists), and ensure the policy cards follow the same header/body structure as the devices/access/breakglass panels for visual rhythm.

findings.summary: The refresh button's RefreshCcw icon lacks aria-hidden, so screen readers may announce it redundantly alongside the visible 'تحديث' label (StatusBadge icons correctly set aria-hidden).
findings.fix: Add `aria-hidden="true"` to the `<RefreshCcw className="size-4"/>` icon (and any other decorative lucide icons rendered next to text) to match the StatusBadge convention.
